brief.note: Retail earnings still driving the biggest falls; consumer demand and guidance cuts the recurring theme.

candidates.name: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.
candidates.business: Largest US sporting goods retailer, now also owner of Foot Locker
candidates.cause: Q2 missed on both lines and full-year sales and profit guidance was cut, with losses at newly acquired Foot Locker driving the shortfall.
candidates.right: Foot Locker's losses must narrow on schedule without further cuts to guidance
candidates.wrong: The Foot Locker acquisition keeps draining profit while athletic footwear demand stays weak

candidates.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
candidates.business: Maker of optical transceivers and lasers for data centres and cable networks
candidates.cause: Launched a $600m at-the-market share sale to fund a capacity build, and investors marked the stock down on dilution risk.
candidates.right: The capacity funded by the raise must convert into the guided revenue ramp
candidates.wrong: Further equity raises dilute holders while the company stays unprofitable
